environment.note: Attacks 2-4 are protocol-level and involve no LLM at all. Attack 1's agent behaviour uses the deterministic stub, which is written to be maximally injectable -- it assumes the model is already fully compromised, which is strictly harder for the guard than a real model that might resist the injection on its own.

vulnerable.name: rendered_vs_signed_divergence
vulnerable.evidence: user reviewed and approved a cart totalling 129900 paise; the cart actually signed and charged totalled 189900 paise (+60000), still within the 200000 paise ceiling, correct merchant, correct category. NOT BLOCKED -- order order_TXtLKgjd8zhkjU created.

detail.why_not_caught: checkout_hash is re-derived from the cart presented at signing time; the cart shown to the user at review time was never signed, so there is no committed reference to diff against

guarded.name: rendered_vs_signed_divergence

detail.why_not_caught: checkout_hash is re-derived from the cart presented at signing time; the cart shown to the user at review time was never signed, so there is no committed reference to diff against

vulnerable.name: cross_verifier_replay
vulnerable.evidence: mandate already consumed by verifier instance 1 (order order_TXtLLHYZYNXxmr) was resubmitted to a second verifier replica with its own nonce store. NOT BLOCKED -- order order_TXtLLNFmkB0ZWn created; the user is charged twice.

detail.why_not_caught: NonceStore is per-instance and opened at ':memory:'; a horizontally scaled deployment gives each replica an empty consumed set
detail.fix_not_built: shared durable nonce store with an atomic insert

guarded.name: cross_verifier_replay
guarded.evidence: mandate already consumed by verifier instance 1 (order order_TXtLLe3Ubmwq0g) was resubmitted to a second verifier replica with its own nonce store. NOT BLOCKED -- order order_TXtLLiiTkZKVMH created; the user is charged twice.

detail.why_not_caught: NonceStore is per-instance and opened at ':memory:'; a horizontally scaled deployment gives each replica an empty consumed set
detail.fix_not_built: shared durable nonce store with an atomic insert
